Your questions belong here

Could the Bible Help You Know the Creator More Deeply?

You may be curious about the Creator, looking for peace, or asking questions about your purpose. You may also wonder whether exploring the Bible means leaving part of yourself behind.

Your name, language, family ties, connection to your people, and pride in being Native.

At Indigenous Podcast, we believe you should not have to surrender your identity to be loved by God. Following Jesus does not require you to become less Native or take on another people’s culture.

Room to read. Space to reflect.

Explore the Questions
That Matter to You

These easy-to-follow guides will help you consider questions such as:

A preview of our introduction

The Creator Made Every People

God created every human being with dignity. His love reaches every nation, family, and generation. No race, church, or culture owns Him.

The Bible does not belong to one race, nation, denomination, or culture. Although it was written within real cultures, its message reaches above and across cultures. It reveals who the Creator is, what He is like, and how people everywhere can know Him through Jesus.

Dignity. Belonging. Respect.

Your History and Your Questions Deserve Respect

We know religious institutions have sometimes shamed Native identity, separated families, and silenced Native languages and traditions. That harm was wrong, and it should never be ignored or excused.

These guides will not ask you to ignore that history, reject your people, or treat your Native identity as something God needs to erase.

Native nations and families have different histories, traditions, and beliefs. These guides offer a respectful place to begin exploring the Bible and Jesus for yourself.

Before you begin

Honest questions.
Clear answers.

Take the time you need to decide whether this is right for you.

What do these Bible guides focus on?+

These guides focus on the Creator of all humankind and unpack the Bible from a biblical perspective. They explore who He is, what He is like, and how we can know Him through what Scripture teaches. You have room to read, think, ask questions, and decide what you believe.

Will I be asked to give up my Native identity?+

Following Jesus does not require you to become less Native or take on another people’s culture. These guides will not ask you to reject your people or treat your Native identity as something God needs to erase.

Native nations and families have different histories, traditions, and beliefs. You have room to consider questions and decide what you believe.

Do I need to know the Bible already?+

No. You do not need to know the Bible already. You can begin exactly where you are, read from home, and move at your own pace.

Do I have to join a church?+

No. You can explore without pressure to join a church. Take time to think about what you believe and study the Bible’s message for yourself.

Who is behind this invitation?+

This invitation comes from Indigenous Podcast. We offer these guides as a respectful place to begin exploring the Bible and Jesus for yourself.

Read about our approach.

What happens when I sign up?+

Enter your name and email in the signup form to receive access to the free online Bible guides. Your email is used to send your guide access. Read the form’s email preferences before submitting.

One quiet moment. One place to begin.

Begin Privately
and at Your Own Pace

With these free online Bible guides, you can:

  • Read from the comfort of home.
  • Move at a pace that feels right for you.
  • Study the Bible’s message for yourself.
  • Take time to think about what you believe.
  • Explore without pressure to join a church.

If you have ever wondered whether you can know the Creator without surrendering who you are, begin here. One guide, one honest question, and one quiet moment with the Creator may open a path you have wanted to explore for years.
